subject: general
question: Who was appointed as the new Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nitin Gupta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nitin Gupta** who was **appointed **as the new **Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) in June 2022 **and is currently (December 2023) serving.
 
• He is an** Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer** from the 1988 batch.
 
• Before being appointed as the CBDT Chairman, he was serving as the **Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax (PCCIT) in Delhi.**
 
• He has also held several other key positions in the Income Tax Department during his career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeeta Singh** is also an **IRS officer** who currently serves as the **Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax in Mumbai**.
 
• She was given additional charge of Chairman of CBDT before Nitin Gupta. She has been in the news recently for leading a crackdown on tax evasion by Bollywood celebrities.
 
• **Jagannath Vidyadhar Mahapatra **is a retired **IRS officer** who served as the **CBDT Chairman from 2015 to 2016.**
 
 
• He is currently a member of the **Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT)**, which is a quasi-judicial body that resolves disputes related to civil service appointments.
 
 
 
• **Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT):**
 
 
• **​**It is a **statutory authority** functioning under the **Central Board of Revenue Act, 1963** under Department of Revenue in the **Ministry of Finance.**
 
• Its **duties **include** creating policies**, **handling issues** **with the imposition and collection of direct taxes**, and **overseeing the operations of the Income Tax Department** as a whole. 
 
• Along with proposed legislative changes to direct tax enactments, it also **suggests adjustments to tax rates and structures to better align with government priorities.**
 
• The CBDT is **headed by Chairman** and also **comprises of six members**, all of whom are ex-officio Special Secretary to the Government of India.
 
 
• Member (Income Tax)
 
• Member (Legislation and Computerization)
 
• Member (Revenue)
 
• Member (Personnel & Vigilance)
 
• Member (Investigation)
 
• Member (Audit & Judicial)
